notes: LOOKAHEAD-SAFE 2018 BACKTEST FILE. Era: 16-game regular seasons (2016-2018); G=16 means a full season. ADP: FantasyFootballCalculator PPR 12-team 2018 preseason mock drafts (fantasyfootballcalculator.com/adp/ppr/12-team/all/2018); 'adp' = the Overall average-pick column quoted verbatim; site listed 197 rows, DEF (15) and PK (14) dropped -> 168 QB/RB/WR/TE rows; FFC renders some CURRENT display names/franchises (e.g. 'Robbie Chosen' = Robby Anderson, 'Keelan Cole Sr.', Lynch/Jordy Nelson team 'LV' = 2018 OAK; 'Patrick Mahomes' ADP 118.1 is his true 2018 preseason ADP). PROJECTIONS RB/WR/TE: FFToday playerproj.php?Season=2018 PosID 20/30/40 (100 RB / 100 WR / 50 TE). The pages carry a site stamp 'Updated: 6/17/2019' but content was verified genuinely preseason-2018 (Le'Veon Bell PIT projected 292.1 half-PPR despite sitting out 2018; Gronkowski TE1; Hunt KC; rookie Barkley RB10) - only display artifacts changed (team column shows renamed franchise OAK->LV). Served FPts column verified by exact recomputation on many rows to be FFToday's half-PPR preset: 0.1/yd + 6/TD + 0.5/reception (e.g. Gurley 1932 scrimmage yds + 15 TD + 71 rec = 283.2+35.5 = 318.7 exact). proj here = served FPts + 0.5*Rec, i.e. FULL-PPR points (0.1/yd + 6/TD + 1.0/rec), matching the actual2018 PPR scale for yardage/TD/receptions. PROJECTIONS QB: FFToday's Season=2018 QB archive is CORRUPTED - it was overwritten 6/17/2019 with early 2019-preseason data (values match their Season=2019 page: Luck 343.2 pre-retirement, 2019 teams Foles JAC/Flacco DEN/Fitzpatrick MIA) and is NOT lookahead-safe, so it was not used. Substitute: FantasyPros consensus draft projections (fantasypros.com/nfl/projections/qb.php?week=draft&year=2018, page states consensus last updated Sep 6, 2018 = pre-season); that page serves only its top-10 QB rows to a non-JS fetch, so projQB has ONLY 10 rows (QBs ranked 11+ such as Brady/Brees/Wilson/Luck are absent) - treat QB projections as partial. FP QB scoring approx 0.04/passYd + 4/passTD - 1/INT + 0.1/rushYd + 6/rushTD (-2/FL), slightly different from FFToday's QB formula; QB proj scale is therefore not identical to the 2019 file's FFToday QB projections. ACTUALS: FantasyPros season-total PPR stats pages (fantasypros.com/nfl/stats/{qb,rb,wr,te}.php?year=2018&scoring=PPR), FPTS and G columns verbatim; 45 QB / 80 RB / 100 WR / 40 TE; anchors verified (Barkley 385.8, Mahomes 417.0, Hopkins 333.5, Kelce 294.6). FantasyPros displays current player names (e.g. 'Nyheim Miller-Hines' = Nyheim Hines, 'Todd Gurley II', 'William Fuller V'); its team column shows current teams and was therefore omitted. GAMES: gamesA = 2016 season G, gamesB = 2017 season G, same FantasyPros stats pages (year=2016/2017), top ~90 per position by that season's PPR rank; QB lists cut at 60 (2016) and 66 (2017) because beyond that FantasyPros' QB table degrades into non-QB junk rows (linemen/K/WRs) - fewer than 90 real QBs record stats. Names are verbatim per source; cross-source joins need normalization (suffixes II/III/Jr./Sr., renamed players, 'LeVeon'/'Le'Veon'). Wayback Machine was unreachable through the fetch proxy (403), so live archives were used with the content-level lookahead verification described above. No values invented; all numbers quoted from the fetched pages (proj = page FPts + 0.5*page Rec arithmetic only).
